mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.author_id, u.username AS author_name, COALESCE(bc.cnt, 0) AS blog_count, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM series s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT series_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM blogs GROUP BY series_id) bc ON bc.series_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.author_id, u.username AS author_name, COALESCE(bc.cnt, 0) AS blog_count, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM series s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT series_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM blogs GROUP BY series_id) bc ON bc.series_id = s.id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO series (name, description, author_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{authorId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.author_id, u.username AS author_name, u.avatar_url AS author_avatar, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM blogs b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id WHERE b.series_id = #{seriesId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blogs WHERE series_id = #{seriesId}
